fields.description: Issue dated Saturday, May 28, 1927, featuring editorials and commentary on the upcoming Miami municipal election and city commissioner candidates, criticism of banker-led city governance, and discussion of taxes, bond issues, and public-utility franchises. Includes coverage of gambling and proposed racing legislation (including pari-mutuels) with references to Hialeah track activity, along with items on Everglades fires and a satirical piece on proposals for a new Miami Beach county. Regular columns and local notes appear alongside substantial advertising and paid political advertisements for city commissioner candidates.
